name: Qmutator
description:
Qmutator turns raw product feeds into clean, validated catalogs — and automates what happens to them, from transformations and image processing to channel-ready exports, through QFlow pipelines.

This connector puts that entire workflow into a conversation:

- Onboard a feed by pasting a URL. Claude inspects the file, proposes a schema and field mappings, verifies them against real samples, and starts the import.
- Interrogate your catalog. "Which products violate the price constraint?" "What values does color actually contain?" — then fix what surfaces, one record at a time or in bulk.
- Build pipelines in plain language. Describe a transformation; Claude assembles the QFlow node graph, validates it, previews the output, and deploys it to a live HTTP endpoint.
- Keep languages and channels straight. Manage per-language field mappings and filtered Export Views without opening the dashboard.

You sign in with your own Qmutator account, and every action runs under your existing company and project roles — nothing is possible here that isn't possible for you in the dashboard. Read-only and destructive operations are clearly annotated, so Claude previews before it changes anything and asks before anything irreversible.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Qmutator to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Qmutator to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.qmutator.com/admin/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Qmutator MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Qmutator lists 61 MCP tools, including create_buckets, create_import_file, create_mutation, create_mutation_version, create_perspective, create_project, delete_bucket, delete_constraint, delete_import_file, delete_mutation, delete_perspective, and delete_schema_field.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Qmutator?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Qmutator in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Qmutator requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Qmutator is developed by Qmutator. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
